note: Staging tally for the automated generation-side learner (TD-0035). Owned by .claude/agents/blog-learner.md — it runs after each post's review loops, abstracts that post's ROUND-1 CONFIRMED gate edits (synthesis's gate tier) into content-agnostic patterns, and tallies them across posts. A pattern promotes into docs/blog-drafter-pitfalls.md only at promoteThreshold distinct posts. Health metrics (rounds/tone per post) live here too — they are a SIGNAL, never the optimization target.

patterns.description: Dismiss-then-reframe or 'I don't X, Y does' negation constructions in outline beats and draft prose.
patterns.scope: outline intendedBeat/ourTake fields; draft closing/summary sentences
patterns.note: already covered by blog-drafter-pitfalls.md #1 Negative parallelism — tracked for provenance only, not re-promoted

patterns.description: Rule-of-three tricolons (A, B, and C; anaphoric 'its own X, its own Y, its own Z') in lists and prose.
patterns.scope: outline lists; draft prose lists and asides
patterns.note: already covered by blog-drafter-pitfalls.md #2 Rule-of-three tricolons — tracked for provenance only, not re-promoted

patterns.description: Outline/draft states a numeric or mechanical fact about our own pipeline (round caps, stage counts, checkpoints) that has drifted from the current value in blog-facts.md.
patterns.scope: outline facts/ourTake fields describing pipeline mechanics
patterns.note: already covered by blog-drafter-pitfalls.md #3 Overclaims about our own pipeline — tracked for provenance only, not re-promoted

patterns.description: Links or Sources-lists an internal /blog/<slug>/ whose pubDate is after this post's own pubDate.
patterns.scope: outline links fields; draft body links and Sources section
patterns.note: already covered by blog-drafter-pitfalls.md #4 Future-dated internal links — tracked for provenance only, not re-promoted

patterns.description: Outline ourTake reads as flat claim, then cited source, then conclusion, with no personal stake, register, or point of view — a view-from-nowhere failure.
patterns.scope: outline ourTake fields, especially ones citing an external stat or policy

patterns.description: Outline/draft conflates internal pipeline implementation (stages built as narrow agents dispatched via the Agent tool) with the public Skills Marketplace's 'skill' terminology.
patterns.scope: outline facts fields describing pipeline architecture

patterns.description: States an absolute ('the only X', 'always Y') about our own system that a later beat in the same outline itself contradicts with a documented exception.
patterns.scope: outline meta/facts fields making universal claims about pipeline behavior

patterns.description: Closes a sentence or section with 'and that's the whole point' (or equivalent) as a lazy emphasis/summary tag instead of landing the actual point.
Reaches for em-dashes by default for asides, contrast, and connectors, pushing draft em-dash density over the tone-gate threshold instead of varying with colons, parens, or sentence breaks.
patterns.scope: draft prose throughout, especially explanatory asides and reviewer/list descriptions

patterns.description: A run of several consecutive sentences with the same length and syntactic shape at a section's emotional or explanatory peak, flattening voice through monotone cadence.
patterns.scope: draft prose, especially mechanism-explanation and emotional-peak sections

patterns.description: Drops a scope/safety qualifier present in the source claim (e.g., 'AI-audited' collapsed to 'audited') when restating a third-party disclaimed claim, turning a hedged assurance into an unqualified one.
patterns.scope: draft prose citing third-party claims or disclaimers (marketplace audits, vendor claims)
